title: Private Idol Disc Vol. 1: Yuu Kinoshita
native_title: プラドル ＤＩＳＣ Ｖｏｌ．１ ～木下優～
overview:
Yuu Kinoshita

An idol for you, and only for you - yes, a Private Idol!

The first volume of the Private Idol Disc series is a digital photo book starring idol Yuu Kinoshita. In the Photo Hall you pick the pictures you want to see from outdoor, studio and private shoots. The Video Hall holds short movies, including her self-introductions and image footage.

- Photo Hall: outdoor, studio and private photo sets
- Video Hall: short video clips
- Bonus: a "look this way" mini game
- Preview of the next volume and production credits
